Subject: New supplier activation — request for priority remit option

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking our call today. As discussed, Solvoy is ready to complete vendor onboarding but we have a short cash conversion window that would materially help our implementation ramp. Two asks:

1) Can Redwood support a "priority remit" option (Net30 default, but vendor can opt into a 2% fee for payment within 7 days)?
2) Is it possible to fast-track our PO intake so we can invoice against the first milestone in April?

I've attached our onboarding forms and W9 so procurement can validate tax and banking details. If helpful, we can sign a short amendment to the master services agreement for the pilot.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Finance Operations
Solvoy Systems

Hi Elena — thanks for the docs and for outlining the ask.

We can support a priority remit pilot, but need procurement sign-off on two things:
- Clear PO workflow and invoice submission format (we prefer PDF + invoice metadata via vendor portal)
- A short pilot amendment that specifies the fee (2% of invoice) and a cap per-month.

Proposed next steps:
1) Kimberley (me) to set up PO & portal access this week so Solvoy can submit milestone invoices.
2) David, can procurement evaluate the fee/operational impact and confirm whether Treasury needs a separate approval?
3) If approved, I can circulate a one-page pilot amendment and DocuSign link for Elena to sign.

If you can confirm the bank remit details on the form, I’ll open the PO today.

Thanks — Kim

Kim / Sean / Elena — thanks for the details. Procurement reviewed the forms and Treasury ran the quick risk check. Summary:

- W9 and bank details validate. No sanctions flags.
- We can approve a limited priority-remit pilot with these guardrails:
  * Standard payment terms: Net45 (to align with Redwood's billing cohort for new suppliers this fiscal quarter).
  * Pilot rapid-pay option: 1.75% fee for payment within 7 business days, capped at $25k per supplier per month.
  * Pilot term: 90 days from first paid invoice; automatic review at day 60 for operational impact.
  * Invoicing format: PDF invoice + portal metadata ID required (we will provide portal template).

Next steps:
1) Kim will send the one-page pilot amendment via DocuSign (link below).
2) Elena to countersign; procurement will set PO-2027-4589 to "Active - Pilot" once DocuSign returns.
3) Sean to confirm AP routing and accounting code mapping for Solvoy invoices.
